registryAssessment: Niger State’s official Ministry of Lands and Survey describes state responsibility for land administration. Its official Certificate of Occupancy guideline includes the Suleja area and requires a survey plan and submission to an Area Land Office; official state sources identify Madalla as a Suleja locality. This evidences a nearby/state land-administration route, but not city-specific public GIS or proof of the exact WUP locator’s record jurisdiction.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Niger State Ministry page describes statewide management and administration of land and landed property.
Official state C-of-O guideline identifies Suleja within its area schedule, requires survey plan and directs applications to area land offices.
Official Niger State Internal Revenue Service lists an Area Tax Office in Madalla with the address Madalla Suleja; this is locality corroboration, not evidence of a land-record office.
Official Niger State Urban Development Board list includes Madalla–Suleja infrastructure route, corroborating local administrative naming.
